identity: Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm is a free 2D side-scrolling platformer you play in your web browser at smokegame.win.
access: There is no download and no wallet.
controls: Controls are the Left and Right arrow keys to move, Spacebar to jump, Enter to throw axes, Shift to sprint, and K for a burst dash.
not_artist: Lil Blunt: The Smoke Realm is a browser game, not the music artist of a similar name.
not_onchain: they are not recorded on a blockchain
